name: Beijinho
author: Georis Samuel on based.cooking

ingredients.item: A can of sweetened condensed milk (395 g)

steps: Mix the sweetened condensed milk, the butter, the table cream, 30g of coconut and a pinch of salt in a saucepan;
On medium-low heat, stir constantly until it thickens.
The right point it's when you use the spatula through the mixture and create a 'path' that takes a while to close.
Turn off the stove, put the dessert on a plate and cover it with plastic wrap
Take it to the refrigerator and let it cool
Grease your hands with butter and make small balls with the mixture you just prepared (the size of each ball is on you, I recommend 18g each);
Roll the balls in the rest of the shredded coconut, place them into small paper cups, and, traditionally, we stick a clove on the top.
